A colossal ancient crimson matriarch at the heart of the brood, twice the size of the rest, vast tattered red wings spread wide, a great crown of recurved horns, lesser dragons wheeling reverently around her.
A battle-scarred black alpha with broken horns and a notched wing leading the migration, longer and darker than all others streaming behind him, his scarred scales swallowing the light.
A vast frost-white elder rimed in ice perched at the roost's summit, broad pale wings mantled over dozens of smaller dragons clustered shivering on the frozen ledges below.
A gleaming gold patriarch banking at the head of the flight, his polished scales blazing like hammered sunlight, immense and regal, the smaller dragons arrayed in formation behind his sweeping wings.
A storm-grey sky-king crackling with arcs of lightning across his ridge of horns, vast and turbulent above the flock, smaller dragons scattering and regrouping in the electric wake of his wingbeats.

A molten volcanic broodmother crouched over a caldera rim, her dark scales seamed with glowing orange cracks, enormous and smoldering, smaller fire-scaled hatchlings and juveniles pressed close around her volcanic bulk.
A bronze war-leader bearing a dozen embedded spear-points in his armored neck, broader and heavier than the warriors flanking him, his scarred horns swept back like a battering ram.

A regal purple monarch with a feathered crest cascading from crown to spine, immense and slow-winged above the brood, his violet scales shimmering iridescent as the lesser dragons bank and bow beneath him.

An immense green moss-scaled elder draped in actual living lichen and creeper vines, vast as a hillside, ancient horns crusted with growth, smaller green dragons roosting along the ridges of his back.

A deep sapphire ocean-dragon dwarfing the coastal brood, her sleek scaled flanks salt-crusted and barnacled at the waterline, great finned horns swept back, lesser sea-drakes circling her enormous silhouette.

A scarlet-and-ash ember queen, her wings perpetually trailing curtains of falling cinders, larger than any other in the fire-brood, her triple crown of black horns towering over the smaller drakes below.

A silver-scaled arctic patriarch with horns like cathedral spires, his wingspan throwing a shadow over the entire glacier roost, lesser ice-drakes huddled in reverent clusters far beneath his outstretched wings.

An enormous rust-red iron-scaled warlord with riveted-looking scale plates and blunt square horns, half again the bulk of the war-drakes flanking him, leading the assault formation with grinding wingbeats.

A pale bone-white death-dragon, ancient and skeletal in silhouette, his immense wingspan casting a pale shadow, cracked ivory horns curling downward, the smaller grey brood-members trailing behind in uneasy silence.

A deep emerald jungle-queen with horns wreathed in bioluminescent moss, sprawled across the canopy like a living mountain, her vast wings flattened wide, smaller green drakes perched along every ridge of her spine.
A tawny desert patriarch the color of sandstone, immense and wind-worn, his horns ground smooth by centuries of grit, the smaller amber-scaled brood circling his enormous bulk above the dune sea.

A midnight-blue celestial elder whose scales reflect constellations, vast and slow-moving across the night sky, curling horns star-silver at their tips, the brood trailing behind him like a comet's scattered tail.

A scarred copper matriarch with verdigris pooling between her scales and one horn sheared at mid-point, massively built and battle-worn, commanding the roost peak while younger copper drakes flank her below.

An obsidian volcanic drake twice the mass of his black-scaled attendants, smooth hornless crown replaced by a ridge of jagged basalt-like protrusions, his weight cracking the stone shelf beneath his clawed feet.

A pale lavender spirit-dragon of immense but ethereal wingspan, her translucent scales sheening with inner light, long spiraling horns ghostly white, the smaller dragons of the brood flying in awed arcs around her.
A dark teal storm-sea leviathan among the coastal brood, his barnacled horns curved like anchors, twice the span of the sea-drakes circling below him, his wings churning the water to white froth.

A golden-bronze elder statesman with a mane of fine bronze spines behind his curved horns, immense and slow, the undisputed patriarch of the highland brood, the younger dragons giving his great bulk wide berth.

A vivid scarlet war-queen, her flame-bright scales nicked with old blade-marks, standing atop the siege mound three times taller than her flanking drakes, curved horns crowned with smoke, leading the charge.

An enormous slate-grey mountain-drake whose mossy, lichen-crusted scales blend into the cliff face, gargantuan and motionless enough to be mistaken for the mountain itself, smaller drakes nesting in the crevices of his folded wings.

A tremendous ivory-and-gold elder, his cream scales edged in pale gold, vast wings spread in the updraft above the entire roost, long spiraling horns glinting, every dragon in the brood angled toward him in deference.
